تستوحون (form X)
# تَسْتَوْحُونَ (tastawḥūna) /tas.taw.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# تُسْتَوْحَوْنَ (tustawḥawna) /tus.taw.ħaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
